checks: Playback controls invoke production media validation and recorded hardware; pushed snapshots change Pause to Play
Previous, next and absolute seek reach the selected session; the timeline updates only through pushed state
Session chips switch Rust selection; paused radio offers Play with disabled skip controls and no fabricated timeline
Middle-click uses the Rust-selected session and never synthesizes an OS key
Scroll uses exact +2 and Shift -1 percentage points; mute is confirmed by a provider event
Mounted player idle time causes no provider reads, IPC polling or timeline timer
Removed selection falls back to the remaining session and resume replaces the subscription; all hardware effects remain recorded
Final session removal produces a truthful empty state and clears the media activity
Verified 23 pushed events with zero unknown IPC, runtime errors or external network
scope: Actual media UI and typed API through a test-only loopback bridge to production MediaProvider service, action validation, activity arbitration and recording hardware. No real GSMTC/audio calls, keys, accounts or OS settings.
